card.name: Frozen shipping and storage handling steps
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, an, the, from, a) right before a storage or packaging container or condition, such as dry ice, an insulated box, a metal cassette, an overpouch or a refrigerator. Seen in shipping, thawing and removal instructions.

modes.label: Shipped or stored on dry ice
modes.description: The word on or an just before dry ice or an insulated shipping box.
modes.example: DO NOT store thawed PAPZIMEOS vials or filled syringes in a refrigerator, freezer, or<< on>> dry ice.

modes.label: Removing from a container
modes.description: The word from or the after a removal verb, before a cassette, overpouch or refrigerator.
modes.example: Use the Pharmacy Bulk Package immediately for admixing after removal<< from>> the overpouch.

card.writes: It suppresses bag, zip and sealed words, so it steers the next word away from bag or pouch terms.
card.plain: It marks the little word before a place or container in handling steps for frozen or cold-chain products.
